t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Each of the gnomes are linked in pairs; orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and blue & purple.Each gnome you pick will lead you to either a bright or dark forest. The orange, green, red and blue gnomes will lead you to the bright forest and the rest will lead you to the dark forest.Each forest will have it's own different amount of mushrooms at that time so you have to work out which one is best.Only the colours of the gnomes matter, everything else about them is irrelevant. You should especially focus on the 5x multipliers to get more mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Hello!Each of the gnomes are "paired" with another gnome and they will always appear together; orange & brown, green & pink, red & yellow and blue & purple.Each gnome will lead you to a different forest with either a red basket or a yellow basket.The orange, green, red and blue gnomes will lead you to a forest with a red basket. And the brown, pink, yellow and purple will take you to a forest with a yellow basket.The amount of available mushrooms in each forest changes every so often so you have to figure out which is the one with the most mushrooms.You will have to pay attention to this, especially when you get the 5x multiplier as you can gain a lot of mushrooms very easily.The gnomes size, hats and positions do NOT matter and makes no difference to the outcome. Only the colour of the gnome matters.Good luck!
